notes: Measured 2026-09-26 (survey export KL-20260926-0946, stride 0.768 m by gps-walk, 3 walk videos). floorHeightM 4.7 from the barometer (1.06 hPa over 2 floors on the elevator ride, 0.112 hPa/m). walkingSpeedMps 1.36 from the three walk videos (111 m in 82 s).
